xray.one_line: Portugal's largest insurer, whose in-house AI reads motor claims, answers the phone and, its AI director told the press, drafts customer messages with language models
xray.what_it_does: Fidelidade, founded in 1808, is the market leader in Portuguese insurance (life and non-life, a 28.1% share), present in 14 countries on 4 continents, with gross written premiums of 6,529 million euros in 2025; Fosun holds about 85% of its capital and Caixa Geral de Depósitos about 15%. Its in-house Center for Artificial Intelligence & Analytics builds the AI it runs: GAMA, which reads claims documents and health invoices; Contact IA, a natural-voice phone line and email triage for its contact centres; Knowledge AI, a language-model assistant over the company's operational knowledge; and Trusty, the virtual assistant on its website and app. Its 2025 report sets out a six-pillar AI strategy that includes fairness, compliance with the AI Act and GDPR, and alignment with the business. [s2, s16, s18, s5, s4, s8, s1]

situations.title: A motor claim read by GAMA, answered by a model
reach: The accident declaration (DAAA) and claim participation the customer uploads, or photographs, in the MyFidelidade app or web area
Extracting and processing the declaration's data automatically, more than half of declarations with no human intervention (April 2025)

Customer communication: 'Toda a nossa comunicação com clientes é hoje produzida por modelos de linguagem' (all our communication with customers is now produced by language models), the AI director said in April 2025
Health expense reimbursements and provider invoices processed through GAMA, including provider billing in Angola and Mozambique
Configurable workflows, fields and integration flows for any line of business, geography or document type
asked_our_example: Read the declaration, extract its fields and pass them to the claims team
When a field is unreadable or ambiguous, hand it to a person (Fidelidade describes this behaviour in GAMA)
No message to the customer and no payment decision without a claims handler's review
gap: Fidelidade publishes the share processed without people and that all customer communication is written by language models, but not where a person reviews a message or a decision before it reaches the customer
The documents GAMA is known to struggle with (folded, phone-photographed declarations) are the ones customers send, and what follows a misread field is not published
The same system reaches reimbursements and provider invoices in other countries; the limits on what it settles there are not published

situations.title: A phone call answered and routed by Contact IA
reach: Identifying and authenticating the caller by natural voice, replacing key navigation
Customer and policy records used to identify the caller (MARIA, the earlier speech bot, identified customers through their policy and other information)
Routing each call to the operator or team it judges most appropriate
Email Automation: classifying incoming customer emails and directing them to teams
Call Analytics over recorded calls, emails and other channels
A path to 'true self-service' that the 2025 report says the architecture will open
asked_our_example: Authenticate the caller and route the call; take no action on the policy
Give a caller's details to an operator only after authentication succeeds
Use recorded interactions for service analytics only
gap: Voice authentication is the gate to the caller's policy data; how it fails, and what an unauthenticated caller can reach, is not published
Self-service is named as the next step, which would move the system from routing calls to acting on them

situations.title: Knowledge AI: one source feeding every AI system
reach: The operational knowledge base: the company's procedures, policies and coverage logic, written and validated by business staff
External systems, reached through a language-model integration layer
Every other AI system in the company, which KAI supplies with business knowledge
Content it creates: FAQs, eLearning and simplified text
Answers that claims managers and brokers rely on for decisions about customers
asked_our_example: Answer staff questions from validated content, with the source shown
Change the knowledge base only through the editor's workflow and permissions
gap: An error or unvalidated change in the base reaches every AI system it feeds, not only the person asking
Which external systems the language-model layer can reach, and whether it can write to them, is not published

questions: GAMA processes more than half of accident declarations without a person: at what point, if any, does a claims handler see a case before the customer is told or paid?
Your AI director said all communication with customers is produced by language models: which messages are reviewed by a person before they are sent?
What can a caller reach after Contact IA's voice authentication, and what will the planned self-service let it change on a policy?
Which external systems can Knowledge AI's language-model layer reach, can it write to any of them, and which AI systems does it feed?
A press report says you integrated Coalex.ai to keep your autonomous agents compliant: which agents are these, and what does a flagged action trigger?

It is read-only: never in the request path.
